package.title: Reliability: Error Handling & Deployment Refresh
package.summary: The contact mailer raises a 500 on any SMTP failure with no user feedback, there is no error tracking (no Sentry/Rollbar), the Capistrano config hardcodes the production IP and SSH port in the repo, and the only deploy path is a 2014-vintage Capistrano 3.2.1 script. This package adds error handling, observability, and a modern deploy pipeline.

findings.title: Contact mailer raises unhandled exceptions; user sees a 500 page
No error tracking service is configured
Capistrano 3.2.1 with hardcoded production IP, port, and SSH key path
No background job processor; mail is sent synchronously in the request
Unicorn before_fork/after_fork hooks reference ActiveRecord directly
No health check endpoint; load balancer cannot verify app health
Log level is hardcoded to :info with no tags
